about.name: About me
about.summary: A little about me. Contact me for more info.
paragraphs: I'm an aspiring upper-secondary engineer in information technology and a real IT enthusiast who enjoys digging into things and solving problems. I like spending my days at the computer and... well, that's where I am.

My main focus is frontend and web development, especially React and Next.js. I've built several websites with a focus on UI/UX, spanning frontend, backend, databases, and deployment. I've worked with different cloud solutions, including Vercel, Supabase, and Firebase, as well as Git and GitHub.

Beyond development, I'm very interested in AI, networks, and infrastructure. I have hands-on experience with virtualization and containers using Proxmox and Docker, as well as my own network environments. I simply enjoy exploring technology and understanding how things work under the hood.
In short: websites, code, computers, networks, or AI - that's what I'm talking about. :)
